verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to recognize a previously verified person or reuse a passed check across sessions or products in place of a full re-run. Flows reuse a session *configuration* (docs-8, docs-9), not a verification result. Accessing past results (docs-16) and limiting verification attempts (docs-19) are adjacent features, and the 'biometric re-log in' remark (comm-15) appears to describe a different product in that thread.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
